Section right_margin returns negative value

#### Description

When accessing the `right_margin` property of a Section object, it returns a negative value instead of the expected positive value.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Create a document and set right margin
doc = Document()
section = doc.sections[0]
section.right_margin = Inches(1)

# Check the right margin value
print(f"Expected: {Inches(1)}")
print(f"Actual: {section.right_margin}")
```

The right margin should return the positive value that was set, but instead returns the negative of that value.
</issue>
